```yaml
name: Devx Version Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  devx_tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_latest_release
        run: |
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
          echo "::set-output name=latest_release::$LATEST_RELEASE"

      - name: Find highest existing .dev* tag
        id: find_highest_dev_tag
        run: |
          DEV_TAGS=$(git tag --list "${{ steps.get_latest_release.outputs.latest_release }}.dev*" | sort -Vr)
          HIGHEST_DEV_TAG=""
          if [ ! -z "$DEV_TAGS" ]; then
            HIGHEST_DEV_TAG=$(echo "$DEV_TAGS" | head -n 1)
          fi
          echo "::set-output name=highest_dev_tag::$HIGHEST_DEV_TAG"

      - name: Determine next .dev tag
        id: determine_next_dev_tag
        run: |
          NEXT_DEV_TAG="${{ steps.get_latest_release.outputs.latest_release }}.dev1"
          if [ ! -z "${{ steps.find_highest_dev_tag.outputs.highest_dev_tag }}" ]; then
            LAST_NUMBER=$(echo "${{ steps.find_highest_dev_tag.outputs.highest_dev_tag }}" | sed 's/.*\.dev\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
            NEXT_NUMBER=$((LAST_NUMBER + 1))
            NEXT_DEV_TAG="${{ steps.get_latest_release.outputs.latest_release }}.dev${NEXT_NUMBER}"
          fi
          echo "::set-output name=next_dev_tag::$NEXT_DEV_TAG"

      - name: Create .dev tag
        run: |
          git tag "${{ steps.determine_next_dev_tag.outputs.next_dev_tag }}"
          git push origin "${{ steps.determine_next_dev_tag.outputs.next_dev_tag }}"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: '.'
          commit: "Automatically created .dev tag ${{ steps.determine_next_dev_tag.outputs.next_dev_tag }}"
          push: true
```
